evals.prompt: I write a weekly B2B newsletter for marketing ops professionals. I've been consistent for 6 months (every Thursday) but I run out of ideas halfway through each month and end up publishing filler content. Help me build an editorial calendar so this stops happening.
evals.expected_output: A calendar that solves the root problem (no theme structure, reactive topic selection) rather than just filling in dates. Should establish 2-3 content themes, produce a 6-8 week calendar, create a structured idea backlog system, and identify a production lead time the user can actually maintain. Should NOT add more content or increase frequency.
expectations: Identifies lack of themes as the root cause, not lack of frequency or format
Produces a calendar table with at least 6 weeks of planned content
Includes an idea capture system with specific sources (FAQs, reader replies, etc.)
Does not recommend increasing publishing frequency
Each week maps to an engagement stage (awareness, consideration, subscription, conversion, loyalty)

evals.prompt: I'm launching a content program from scratch. I want to publish 5 blog posts per week, a daily LinkedIn post, a weekly newsletter, and a monthly webinar. I have one part-time content writer. What should my editorial calendar look like?
evals.expected_output: The skill should push back hard on this production plan as unsustainable. Should explain the consistency-over-frequency rule, estimate realistic production capacity for one part-time writer, recommend a minimum viable content plan (probably 1 blog/week + 1 newsletter/week or similar), and build a calendar around the sustainable plan — not the aspirational one.
expectations: Explicitly pushes back on the production plan as unsustainable with one part-time writer
Recommends a scaled-down plan the team can actually maintain for 24 months
Does not produce a calendar for the 5-posts-per-week plan without pushback
Final calendar reflects realistic capacity, not aspirational volume

evals.prompt: I run a podcast for HR leaders at companies with 200-500 employees. One episode per week. I've never planned more than 2-3 episodes ahead. Help me set up an editorial calendar with themes and plan the next 8 weeks.
evals.expected_output: An 8-week podcast editorial calendar with two monthly themes, each episode mapped to a content angle and engagement stage, plus a production workflow that accounts for podcast-specific lead times (recording, editing, show notes, promotion). Should include recurring segment recommendations to reduce planning load.
expectations: Output covers 8 weeks of planned episodes in table format
Recommends recurring segments to reduce per-episode planning burden
Includes podcast-specific production workflow (record, edit, show notes, publish schedule)
Episodes map to engagement stages appropriate for a podcast audience
Suggests a buffer of 2-3 completed but unpublished episodes
